title.en: An Act Providing For the Conversion of Selected Municipal Main Health Centers As May Be Determined By Members of the House of Representatives and By the Department of Health Into Municipal Health Infirmaries, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: Declaration of Policy . – It is hereby declared the policy of the State to give primary concern to the promotion, protection, preservation or restoration of the health of the people through the provision and delivery of basic care services.

Conversion of Municipal Main Health Centers to Municipal Health Infirmaries. – Pursuant to the above policy, selected municipal main health units as may be determined by the Members of the House of Representatives and the Department of Health shall be converted into five-bed capacity municipal health infirmaries.

Selection of Sites for Municipal Health Infirmary. – The regional health director through the provincial health officer shall recommend the main health centers which shall be converted into municipal health infirmaries in accordance with the criteria set forth in the preceding section: Provided, That, in the first year of implementing this Act, the health infirmaries shall be established in municipalities and cities enumerated in the attached list.

Responsibilities and Duties. – The municipal health infirmary shall have the following responsibilities and duties:
a. Admit and extend first-aid treatment for emergency cases;
b. Transfer or refer patients to better-equipped government or private hospitals when necessary as soon as such patients are out of immediate danger; and
c. Provide basic health service to the people.

Staffing Pattern and Required Personnel. – The existing medical staff and personnel of the municipal main health units concerned shall constitute the personnel of the infirmaries so established and, in addition thereto, without prejudice to appointing additional health personnel as may be determined necessary by the Department of Health.

Transfer of Personnel, Assets and Records. – The properties, records, obligations and appropriations of the municipal main health units concerned shall be transferred to the infirmaries so established.
Rules and Regulations. – The Secretary of Health shall issue the necessary rules and regulations for the effective implementation of this Act.
Appropriations. – The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
